apply_order.sheet: 1) replace each sheet_sequences key (literal strings); 2) map each char via sheet; 3) apply each sheet_rules [regex, replacement] in order with Python re.sub

notes.sheet:ë: Vocalic ṛ after a consonant (këæhña = kṛṣṇa). After a vowel and before a consonant it is plain r (saëvva = sarvva, mûëtti = mūrtti); between vowels it is Malayalam ṟ, which 2025 writes ṙ (maëannu = maṙannu). dec rule: vowel+ë+consonant -> r, else ṛ.
notes.sheet:ñ: ṇ in ~97% of uses; next to c/j (ñc, ñj, jñ) it is the palatal ñ. dec rule handles that.
notes.sheet:å / æ: Written as the digraphs åh / æh (Åha = Śa, lakæhmi = lakṣmi); the h is part of the letter and must be dropped. A bare å/æ (without h) also means ś/ṣ.
notes.sheet:ç: Only occurs in çh = zh (Malayalam/Tamil ḻ); maps to plain z so çh -> zh, matching both songbooks' zh spelling.
notes.sheet:¨: Precedes u (275/275) in word-final Malayalam/Tamil -kku, -ttu, -ṇḍu: the half-u (samvruthokaram) mark. Both songbooks write plain u, so it is dropped.
notes.sheet:ø vs d: ø is ṭ; but the sheets often spell intervocalic Malayalam ṭ as d (kâttidu = kāṭṭiṭu), a spelling choice not a font char.
notes.sheet:ä, ¸, ¯, ’: ä (5x), ¸ (2x), ¯ (1x) are isolated typos with no consistent counterpart; left unmapped. ’ is punctuation.
notes.sheet:Æ: 5x; Æh = Ṣ (Æhañmukhâ), but once 'Ananta Æayana' = Śayana (typo for Å).
notes.sheet:Ø, Ö, È, Û: Uppercase forms seen 1-9x only; mapped by analogy with the lowercase (ØhOkar = Ṭhokar, Èamarû = Ḍamarū).
notes.songbook_legacy:ä: ṛ in Sanskrit words (amätam = amṛtam); also Malayalam ṟ, which 2025 writes ṙ (aäivu = aṙivu). Map ä -> ṛ; normalise ṙ -> ṛ on the Unicode side to compare.
notes.songbook_legacy:ê: ṅ (saêkaâa = saṅkaṭa); the songbooks also spell Malayalam ññ as êê (teîiêêu = teḷiññu), so ṅṅ vs ññ must be treated as equal.
notes.songbook_legacy:â: ṭ; 2025 often writes intervocalic Malayalam ṭ as ḍ (pàâum = pāḍum) and ṟṟ as ṫṫ (kàââil = kāṫṫil). Spelling, not font.
notes.songbook_legacy:ç: ṣ; some words use ç where 2025 has ś (kèçava = kēśava, darçan = darśan) — the songbook's own spelling.
notes.songbook_legacy:ë: Rare (vol3/6/7): anusvara ṁ (oë = oṁ, éaraåaë = śaraṇaṁ, annaiyuë = annaiyum).
notes.songbook_legacy:ö, õ: Rare stray variants of ō (möhana, varumö, asatö; jõ, hamkõ, ilaipõl).
notes.songbook_legacy:û: Variant of ù = ū (mûrttè = mūrttē, anugrahikkû).
notes.compare: Before comparing, also fold ṙ->ṛ, ṫ->ṭ, ḍ<->ṭ (Malayalam), ṅṅ<->ññ, c<->ch, ny<->ñ, ṁ->m, and drop hyphens/spaces.
